query: 供应商行为准则 供应商行为准则 衡量企业要求其供应商在劳工权益、人权保障、环境保护及商业道德（如反腐败、反洗钱）等方面遵循的正式规范。重点考察条款的完整性、对违约行为的处置机制以及对准则内容的培训沟通。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：准则内容完全对齐国际基准（如 RBA, ILO）；具备阶梯式的违约惩戒与终止合作机制；设立了针对供应商的常态化合规培训计划；且准则包含“向下穿透”要求（要求其供应商也签署类似协议）。 • 1分（合格）：有正式的供应商行为准则或包含在通用采购条款中，涵盖了基础的合规、廉洁与劳工要求，但缺乏具体的违约处理流程、定期的培训赋能或深度的人权/环境保护细节。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关供应商行为准则披露，或仅有笼统的“要求供应商诚信合规”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：已签署并执行准则的供应商数量或采购总额占比 >80%，并披露了对高风险供应商的强制签署情况。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅核心一级供应商签署而忽略了次级或长尾供应商，或未说明具体签署/覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 供应商行为准则 供应商标准 违约终止 阶梯式惩戒 供应商合规培训 向下穿透 次级供应商 供应商签署 高风险供应商强制签署 采购额覆盖率 RBA ILO supplier code of conduct supplier standards RBA ILO standards breach escalation termination supplier compliance training cascading requirements flow-down requirements sub-tier suppliers supplier acknowledgement mandatory signing for high-risk suppliers 是否有正式供应商行为准则？ 是否覆盖劳工、人权、环境、反腐败等条款？ 违约惩戒与终止合作机制是什么？ 是否对供应商开展合规培训？ 是否要求向下穿透，签署覆盖多少采购额/供应商？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '供应商行为准则'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有正式供应商行为准则？ 是否覆盖劳工、人权、环境、反腐败等条款？ 违约惩戒与终止合作机制是什么？ 是否对供应商开展合规培训？ 是否要求向下穿透，签署覆盖多少采购额/供应商？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“要求诚信合规”；仅有供应商环境标准而无劳工/道德；仅有廉洁协议单点；仅有员工行为准则；区分：供应商行为准则是综合规范；供应商环境标准、反腐败管理是其中专题深化；申诉机制是渠道；道德采购偏采购策略与冲突矿产等议题。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: The Group procures raw materials from the market for producing magnesium metal and magnesium alloys. The Group has developed corresponding inspection, assessment and selection procedures for raw materials suppliers. [Content]
The Group procures raw materials from the market for producing magnesium metal and magnesium alloys. The Group has developed corresponding inspection, assessment and selection procedures for raw materials suppliers. Upon receipt of bids from raw materials suppliers, the Group assesses comprehensively from the aspects of brand, quality, payment, schedule of delivery, reputation, and after-sales service, and seriously considering their energy and environmental policy to maximise environmental protection and minimise pollution. The most appropriate product supplier is determined based on a comprehensive score and ranking assessment by comparing individual suppliers. It ensures that premium-quality raw materials can be sourced at competitive prices, and the values of the selected supplier on environment, community and ethics are embraceable. All of the Group's suppliers are located in mainland China. There are about 10 major suppliers. During the Reporting Period, there were no material instances of non-compliance concerning the supply chain management.

results.text: The Group strictly abides by the laws and regulations of the PRC government, including the 'Labour Law' and the 'Labour Contract Law'. When the human resources department conducts recruitment work, it shall strictly verify the personal identity of the applicant and perform background checks well to avoid child labour. Employees at production bases are recruited of their own accord. The staff induction process is carried out in line with corporate systems and procedures where no child labour is employed. The ages of all employees satisfy the requirements of local laws. The phenomenon of forced labour does not exist. If any illegal employment of child labour or forced labour is discovered, the Group will immediately terminate the employment contract, identify the cause and pursue responsibility, and impose appropriate penalties on the employee and related person in violation.
